    p.Date_Payment_Made,
    p.Amount_Payment
FROM 
    Payments p
JOIN 
    Settlements s ON p.Settlement_ID = s.Settlement_ID

    Claims c ON s.Claim_ID = c.Claim_ID

    Customer_Policies cp ON c.Policy_ID = cp.Policy_ID

    p.Payment_Method_Code IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY 
    p.Date_Payment_Made ASC
